data.narrative:
Skild AI, a Series C-stage AI & Software company founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, commands a current post-money valuation of $14.0B following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. The peer universe consists of 9 comparable companies across AI and software infrastructure—1 public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private firms including Figure AI, Waymo, Scale AI, and Reflection AI.

Two valuation methods apply to this stage. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier to the $14.0B last post-money valuation, implying $23.8B. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Figure AI at $39.0B, Wayve at $8.6B, Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, and Black Forest Labs at $3.2B) yields a median of $7.1B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $39.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneous technology maturity and commercialization progress within frontier AI.

Triangulation across these two methods supports a valuation range of $6.0B (conservative floor) to $27.4B (stage-progression ceiling), with a median of $15.4B. The current $14.0B valuation sits near the lower bound of this range. Key uncertainties include commercial traction relative to peers, technical defensibility, and capital efficiency—factors not fully captured in peer multiples alone. Additional operational and revenue data would meaningfully narrow this band.
